title: What the work changed
purpose: Summarize the decisions that improved the project.
takeaway: The strongest progress came from narrowing claims, preserving evidence, and exposing failure states to the reviewer.

bullets: Dataset limits shaped the product language and evaluation design.
Retention and provenance became prerequisites for trustworthy generation.
A visible abstention or error beats a silent fallback when evidence or models are unavailable.

speaker_notes: Connect each lesson to a concrete decision shown earlier.
